name: Fröndenberg/Ruhr (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Fröndenberg/Ruhr (a blue saint on yellow above a red and white chequy base).
history: Municipal flag of Fröndenberg/Ruhr; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
